title: A real visual editor
subtitle: Click text, an image or a button on the page and edit it right there. Nothing to install and no code to touch.

items.title: Click to edit
items.text: Change words, photos, links and buttons directly on the page, with undo and redo whenever you need them.

items.title: 200+ widgets
items.text: Headings, forms, galleries, pricing, FAQs, calculators and more, searchable and sorted into categories.

items.title: Layouts that start empty
items.text: Pick a column, grid, sidebar or hero layout and fill each place with your own widgets. 75+ layouts, no fake content.

items.title: Page structures
items.text: Business, education, portfolio, shop and service skeletons: labelled empty sections you complete yourself.

items.title: Headers and footers
items.text: Choose from many header and footer styles. They are shared, so one change updates every page, and the menu follows your pages.

items.title: Desktop, tablet, mobile
items.text: Switch the preview size as you work. Columns stack on phones and become two columns on tablets.

items.title: Ready-made templates
items.text: Browse templates by kind of business, preview them on three screen sizes, and open one in the editor with your details filled in.

items.title: Colours at three levels
items.text: Change colours for the whole site, for one page, or for a single section. Header and footer colours too.

items.title: Starting designs
items.text: Choose a look first, then pick your pages. You get a working starter site to change, not an empty screen.

title: Take it live, or take it with you

items.title: Publish
items.text: Publish your site to its own address and update it any time by editing and publishing again.

items.title: Export
items.text: Download your whole site as HTML files or a ZIP and host it wherever you like. What you export matches the editor.

items.title: Enquiries inbox
items.text: Contact forms on your site send messages to an Enquiries page in your workspace.

title: See it for yourself
subtitle: Start with a template or a blank page. It takes a few minutes to have something real on screen.

title: From idea to website in
subtitle: No code, no waiting. Answer a few questions, choose a starting point, then edit the page the way you would edit a document.

items.label: Your idea
items.title: Tell us what you are building
items.text: Choose the kind of website: business, school, restaurant, portfolio and more. This decides which designs and pages we suggest first.

items.label: Your details
items.title: Add your business details
items.text: Name, a short description, and, if you want, a tagline, contact details and a logo. We reuse them everywhere so you never type them twice.

items.label: Your design
items.title: Pick how to start
items.text: Two ways in, and you can switch later.
points: Choose a template: browse designs for your kind of business, preview them, and open one.
Create a site: choose a starting design and your pages, then build the rest with 200+ widgets.

items.label: Make it yours
items.title: Edit visually
items.text: Click anything to change it. Add sections from the layout list, drop widgets in, and set your colours. Check desktop, tablet and mobile as you go.

items.label: Go live
items.title: Preview and publish
items.text: Preview your pages, then publish or download the site. Your project stays in your workspace so you can come back and change it.

title: Good websites should be within reach.
subtitle: Give people the tools to tell their story online, with the freedom to make it their own.

paragraphs: A shop owner, a school, a coaching class or a freelancer should be able to put a clear, good-looking website online in an afternoon. Too many builders ask you to learn their jargon first, or hide the useful parts behind a wall of templates you cannot change.

{brand} starts from a different idea: tell us what you do, pick a starting point, and change anything by clicking it. Layouts begin empty, templates stay fully editable, and your site is yours to take away.

title: Quick answers,
subtitle: How to start, how to edit, and how to publish. Can’t find what you need? Write to us.

items.title: Create your account
items.text: Sign up with your email or Google. Your sites are saved to your workspace.

items.title: Choose how to start
items.text: From the start page pick “Choose a template” or “Create a site”.

items.title: Edit by clicking
items.text: Click text, images or buttons on the page. The panel on the right shows what you can change.

items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. You edit by clicking, and everything is built from ready blocks you can move and style.

items.question: What is the difference between a template and a layout?
items.answer: A template is a finished, designed website. A layout is an empty skeleton, such as two columns or a sidebar, that you fill with widgets of your own.

items.question: How do I add a page?
items.answer: Open the Pages tab in the editor and press +. Name the page, and it appears in your header menu automatically.

items.question: How do I change my colours?
items.answer: Use Theme colours for the whole site, Page colours for one page, and Style for a single section.

items.question: Will my site work on phones?
items.answer: Yes. Use the Desktop, Tablet and Mobile buttons at the top of the editor to check each size as you work.

items.question: How do I publish?
items.answer: Use the publish or download buttons in the editor. You can also export the site as HTML files or a ZIP to host yourself.

items.question: Where do contact-form messages go?
items.answer: To the Enquiries page in your workspace.

items.question: Can I undo a mistake?
items.answer: Yes. Use Undo and Redo at the top, or the keyboard shortcuts. Replacing a page’s layout always asks first, and you can undo it.

items.question: Who owns my website?
items.answer: You do. You can download all of it whenever you like.

items: Is the free plan really free?
Yes. You can build, publish and export websites without paying. There is no card needed to start.
The items marked “planned” above are what we are working towards. Nothing marked planned is available yet, and we will say so plainly when it is.
Can I take my website with me?
Yes. You can download your site as HTML files or a ZIP and host it anywhere.
Who do I ask about teams or agencies?
Use the contact form and tell us how you work. We read every message.

title: Your first website starts here
subtitle: Explore the full editor, publish your site and keep a copy. No payment card needed.

items: Do I need to know how to code?
No. Start with your business details or a short description, choose a template, and edit visually. You can change text, images, layouts and colours in the editor.
Can I use my own website design?
Yes. Import an HTML file or a website ZIP from the template library. You can also start with one of the ready-to-edit designs and make it your own.
Will my website work on mobile?
The templates include responsive layouts. Use the desktop, tablet and mobile previews to check your content and refine it before publishing.
Can I update my website after publishing?
Yes. Open your saved site, make changes in the editor, and publish again. Your website and customer enquiries stay together in your workspace.
